Recommend this execution outline and test plan (all allocations are recommendations): Video $150K — Vendor B $125K split into Completed‑View‑optimized (VTR) $75K and Site‑Visit‑optimized (clicks) $50K, + $25K other premium; Programmatic $200K — Vendor C $150K (Prospecting $100K / Retargeting $50K) + $50K other DSPs (prospecting/retargeting split 60/40); Paid Social $100K (prospecting $80K / retargeting $20K); Search $50K (non‑branded $30K / branded $20K).  
Priority test cells at launch (2–3 per channel): Video — A: Vendor B completed‑view vs B: Vendor B site‑visit optimization; Programmatic — A: Vendor C contextual prospecting vs B: Vendor C modeled lookalikes vs C: retargeting with sequential creative; Paid Social — A: 1% lookalike vs B: 3% lookalike and creative A/B (15s motion vs static); Search — A: manual CPC non‑branded vs B: Max‑conv bidding + ad copy test.  
How we’ll judge partners and expected marginal lift: primary KPIs = cost per conversion (CPA), cost per site visit (CPSV), and incremental conversions vs holdout; vendor scoring will use CPA, CPSV, CTR, and view‑through rate for video plus incremental lift from a holdout test — expect highest marginal conversion lift from retargeting and search, then paid‑social retargeting and Vendor B’s site‑visit video line.
